title: German Oats Pudding
description: A traditional German-inspired oats pudding that's perfect for a comforting breakfast or snack, made with energizing ingredients.
instructions: In a large saucepan, combine the oats, milk, and pudding mix. Cook over medium heat, stirring constantly, until the mixture comes to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low and simmer for 5 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Remove the saucepan from the heat and stir in the honey and vanilla extract.
Let the pudding cool to room temperature.
Refrigerate the pudding for at least 2 hours or overnight.
Serve the pudding chilled, garnished with your choice of toppings.
